full_text_en:
Shanghai Di'ai Building Materials Co., Ltd. v. Shanghai Pudong New Area
People's Government — administrative approval dispute

Ruling Summary

During an accident investigation, the main duties of the accident investigation team are to ascertain the circumstances of the accident, determine liability for the accident, and submit an accident investigation report. The participation of investigation team members in the accident investigation constitutes an official act. To maintain the objectivity and fairness of the accident investigation, if the administrative organ to which a member of the investigation team belongs has an interest in the outcome of the accident investigation, both the administrative organ and its staff members shall recuse themselves.

Plaintiff: Shanghai Di'ai Building Materials Co., Ltd., domiciled at Dagu Highway, Fengxian District, Shanghai.
Legal Representative: Wang Huhuan, General Manager of the company.

Defendant: Shanghai Pudong New Area People's Government, domiciled at Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.
Legal Representative: Hang Yingwei, District Mayor.

The plaintiff, Shanghai Di'ai Building Materials Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Di'ai Company), being dissatisfied with the reply made by the defendant, Shanghai Pudong New Area People's Government (hereinafter referred to as Pudong New Area Government), under Document No. Pufu'an [2019] 16, entitled "Reply on the 'Investigation Report on the '11.19' Vehicle Injury Death Accident at Shanghai Di'ai Building Materials Co., Ltd.'" (hereinafter referred to as the Disputed Reply), filed a lawsuit with the First Intermediate People's Court of Shanghai.

Plaintiff's Allegations

The plaintiff, Di'ai Company, alleged that the factual findings and liability determinations in the "Investigation Report on the '11.19' Vehicle Injury Death Accident at Shanghai Di'ai Building Materials Co., Ltd." (hereinafter referred to as the Accident Investigation Report) were erroneous, and that the composition of the accident investigation team was unlawful. The specific reasons were as follows:
1. The project owner of the involved project was the Zhangjiang Town People's Government of Pudong New Area, Shanghai (hereinafter referred to as Zhangjiang Town Government). The general contractor was Shanghai Pudong New Area Construction (Group) Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Pu Construction Company). The subcontractor was Shanghai Yuanxun Construction Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Yuanxun Company). The supervising unit was Shanghai Shenzhu Construction Supervision Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Shenzhu Supervision Company). All of the above units had safety production supervision responsibilities for the construction site of the involved project. However, at the time of the accident, none of these units had personnel on site, and they should each bear responsibility. Di'ai Company was merely a supplier to Yuanxun Company and had no safety management obligations for the construction site. The relationship between Di'ai Company and the deceased, Wang Qicai, was merely a transportation contract relationship, with one being the consignor and the other the carrier. According to the motor vehicle driving license of the accident vehicle, the vehicle was owned by Shanghai Hongjian Automobile Sales Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Hongjian Company), and Di'ai Company had entrusted Hongjian Company with the transportation of goods. As the consignor, Di'ai Company had no safety management duties toward the carrier, Wang Qicai. Moreover, at the time of the accident, Wang Qicai was not transporting goods for the plaintiff but for others.
2. The composition of the accident investigation team was unlawful. First, Zhangjiang Town Government should have recused itself. As the project owner, Zhangjiang Town Government itself had safety production management duties. However, Zhangjiang Town Government participated as a member of the accident investigation team during the investigation, affecting the investigation and handling of the case. Second, the Pudong New Area Supervision Commission's failure to sign the attendance sheet indicated that it did not participate in the accident investigation. The accident investigation team lacked necessary members. In summary, the Disputed Reply and the Accident Investigation Report were unlawful in both substance and procedure. Therefore, the plaintiff requested the court to revoke the Disputed Reply and the Accident Investigation Report made by the defendant, Pudong New Area Government.

Defendant's Defense

The defendant, Pudong New Area Government, argued that it made the Disputed Reply in accordance with the relevant provisions of the "Regulations on the Reporting, Investigation and Handling of Production Safety Accidents" (hereinafter referred to as the Safety Accident Regulations). It was a competent subject, lawful and valid. The accident investigation and handling were scientific, rigorous, in accordance with laws and regulations, based on facts, and in compliance with legal procedures. The plaintiff, Di'ai Company, unlawfully entrusted and contracted the transportation of sidewalk bricks to a third party, Wang Qicai. The accident occurred during the performance of the business entrusted and contracted out by the plaintiff. The plaintiff had an inescapable safety management obligation regarding Wang Qicai's transportation and loading/unloading operations. Regarding the composition of the accident investigation team, the Safety Accident Regulations do not provide for circumstances requiring recusal. Zhangjiang Town Government, as the local people's government, participating in the accident investigation team did not violate the law. Article 22 of the Safety Accident Regulations stipulates the composition of the accident investigation team. Due to the adjustment of institutional functions, the relevant functions of the People's Procuratorate were transferred to the Supervision Commission. Therefore, the accident investigation team invited the supervisory authority to send personnel to participate, but they did not sign the roster. The plaintiff's claims lacked factual and legal basis, and the defendant requested the court to reject the plaintiff's claims.

Facts Found by the Court of First Instance

The project owner of the involved project was Zhangjiang Town Government. The general contractor was Pu Construction Company. The subcontractor was Yuanxun Company. The supervising unit was Shenzhu Supervision Company. Yichen Company was the supplier of road stone materials to Yuanxun Company. Yichen Company subcontracted the supply of sidewalk bricks to the plaintiff, Di'ai Company, for provision to Yuanxun Company. Di'ai Company entrusted Wang Qicai with the transportation of goods at the project site and settled freight payments with Wang Qicai. Around 13:10 on November 19, 2018, Wang Qicai was reversing a forklift that had been parked at the project site a few days earlier from the ground onto the truck bed via a homemade iron ramp. The support on the east side could not withstand the weight of the forklift, deformed and broke, causing the forklift to lose balance and tip over, pinning Wang Qicai underneath. Colleagues at the scene immediately called the emergency number "120." Upon arrival, the paramedics confirmed that Wang Qicai was dead.

Pudong New Area Government entrusted the former Pudong Administration of Work Safety to organize an accident investigation team to investigate general production safety accidents (excluding special equipment accidents). After the accident, the former Pudong Administration of Work Safety, the Pudong Branch of the Shanghai Public Security Bureau, Zhangjiang Town Government, and other government departments formed an investigation team that went to the scene to investigate and gather evidence, drafting the Accident Investigation Report. On January 25, 2019, the investigation team members discussed and approved the Accident Investigation Report. On February 12, 2019, the former Pudong Administration of Work Safety submitted the Accident Investigation Report to the defendant. On February 22, 2019, the defendant issued the Disputed Reply. On March 13, 2019, the Accident Investigation Report and the Disputed Reply were served on the plaintiff, Di'ai Company. The plaintiff, dissatisfied with the findings on the cause and responsibility of the accident in the Disputed Reply, filed this lawsuit, requesting the court to revoke the Disputed Reply and the Accident Investigation Report made by the defendant.

Opinion of the Court of First Instance

The issue in dispute at first instance was whether Zhangjiang Town Government, as the project owner of the involved project, could participate as a member of the accident investigation team on behalf of the local people's government.

According to Article 28 of the Safety Accident Regulations, members of the accident investigation team shall act with integrity and fairness, diligently perform their duties, abide by the discipline of the accident investigation team, and maintain the confidentiality of the accident investigation. The court held that fairness includes not only substantive fairness but also procedural fairness. In this case, Zhangjiang Town Government was both the local people's government of the accident site and the project owner of the new road project identified in the Accident Investigation Report. According to the relevant provisions of the "Production Safety Law of the People's Republic of China" and the "Regulations on the Safety Management of Construction Projects," Zhangjiang Town Government had corresponding safety production responsibilities for the safety of the project construction and was a subject of investigation for the involved production safety accident, potentially bearing corresponding safety production responsibilities. It should not have been excluded from the scope of investigation before the investigation began. Article 22 of the Safety Accident Regulations stipulates that, depending on the specific circumstances of the accident, the accident investigation team shall be composed of personnel from the relevant people's government, the work safety supervision and management department, relevant departments with responsibilities for work safety supervision and management, supervisory authorities, public security organs, and trade unions, and shall invite personnel from the People's Procuratorate to participate. This article does not explicitly stipulate which level of local people's government should participate in the accident investigation team, and according to this article, the composition of the accident investigation team shall be determined based on the specific circumstances of the accident. Because Zhangjiang Town Government bore safety production responsibilities, it was a subject of investigation. Its participation as a member of the accident investigation team in conducting the accident investigation violated the principle of due process. The defendant, Pudong New Area Government, should not have required, approved, or accepted Zhangjiang Town Government's sending of personnel to participate in the accident investigation team. The defendant's approval of the Accident Investigation Report made by that investigation team was clearly improper. The defendant should reorganize the accident investigation team in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Production Safety Law, the Safety Accident Regulations, etc., to ascertain the facts, apply the law, determine liability, and fulfill its relevant statutory duties.

In summary, the Disputed Reply made by the defendant, Pudong New Area Government, violated legal procedures. The plaintiff, Di'ai Company's request to revoke the Disputed Reply had factual and legal basis and should be supported. The First Intermediate People's Court of Shanghai, in accordance with Article 70(3) of the "Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China," on March 6, 2020, ruled as follows:

1. Revoke Document No. Pufu'an [2019] 16, the "Reply on the 'Investigation Report on the '11.19' Vehicle Injury Death Accident at Shanghai Di'ai Building Materials Co., Ltd.,'" made by the defendant, Shanghai Pudong New Area People's Government, on February 22, 2019;
2. Order the defendant, Shanghai Pudong New Area People's Government, to re-make an administrative act within ninety days from the date this judgment takes effect.

Pudong New Area Government, dissatisfied with the first-instance judgment, appealed to the Shanghai High People's Court, requesting the court of second instance to reverse the first-instance judgment and uphold the Disputed Reply it had made.

Appellant's Arguments

The appellant, Pudong New Area Government, argued that the participation of local government personnel in the accident investigation team is a statutory system. Members of the investigation team have clear and irreplaceable responsibilities in the accident investigation. The investigation team consists of specific investigators. According to the relevant provisions, the object of recusal should be the members of the investigation team, not the member units. The accident investigation team has sufficient institutional design to ensure the fairness of the investigation. The participation of local government personnel in the accident investigation does not affect the fairness of the investigation. The accident investigation does not involve the allocation of civil liability. The involved accident occurred during transportation services, not during construction. As the project owner, Zhangjiang Town Government's safety responsibilities were limited to the construction project and had no connection with the involved accident. Its strict compliance with legal requirements in organizing the accident investigation was intended to maintain procedural fairness. Presuming that a unit with no direct connection bears safety responsibility expands the scope of the accident investigation.

Appellee's Defense

The appellee, Di'ai Company, argued that the project owner, the contractor, subcontractors, and the supervising unit were all subjects of investigation. Zhangjiang Town Government, as the project owner and constructor of the involved project, was a direct responsible party and should be a subject of investigation. The relationship between Di'ai Company and Wang Qicai was an entrusted transportation relationship. No road traffic accident occurred during transportation, so the plaintiff should not bear responsibility. The transport vehicle had a affiliated entity, but the accident investigation team did not investigate the affiliated entity. The appellee requested that the appeal be dismissed and the first-instance judgment be upheld.

The Shanghai High People's Court, upon second-instance trial, confirmed the facts found by the first-instance court.

Opinion of the Court of Second Instance

The involved production safety accident resulted in one death and was a general accident. According to Article 19(2), Article 29, and Article 32 of the State Council's Safety Accident Regulations, the former Pudong Administration of Work Safety, upon delegation by the appellant, Pudong New Area Government, organized an investigation team to investigate the "11.19" accident, drafted the Accident Investigation Report, and submitted it to Pudong New Area Government. Pudong New Area Government's issuance of the reply within the statutory period of 15 days after receiving the Accident Investigation Report was in compliance with the law. As the people's government responsible for investigating the involved accident, Pudong New Area Government had the statutory duty to make the Disputed Reply after receiving the Accident Investigation Report submitted by the investigation team. Articles 22(2) and 23 of the Safety Accident Regulations provide that the main duties of the accident investigation team are to ascertain the circumstances of the accident, determine liability for the accident, and submit the accident investigation report.

Government departments generally do not directly engage in production and business activities. Under normal circumstances, the participation of the local people's government in the accident investigation team to participate in the accident investigation and determine accident liability is conducive to providing service support and related social management work. However, in this case, Zhangjiang Town Government was the project owner of the involved project. Under these specific circumstances, Zhangjiang Town Government had corresponding safety production responsibilities for the safety production of the involved project construction and could potentially be a subject of investigation for the involved production safety accident. It should not have been excluded from the scope of investigation before the investigation began. The participation of Zhangjiang Town Government staff in the accident investigation team, participating in the investigation and determining accident liability, clearly violated the principle of due process. The appellant, Pudong New Area Government's approval of the Accident Investigation Report made by that investigation team was clearly improper. The first-instance court correctly concluded that Pudong New Area Government's issuance of the Disputed Reply violated legal procedures, and the judgment revoking the reply and ordering Pudong New Area Government to re-make an administrative act within ninety days from the date the first-instance judgment took effect was correct.

To accurately ascertain the cause of the accident, determine the nature and responsibility of the accident, and maintain the objectivity and fairness of the accident investigation, the organization of the accident investigation team should not only strictly follow laws and regulations but also consider the specific circumstances of each accident case to eliminate reasonable doubts about the fairness of the accident investigation. The accident investigation team consists of specific investigators. The regulations have clearly stipulated that members of the accident investigation team shall have no direct interest in the accident under investigation. Based on the principle of due process, to prevent bias and eliminate reasonable doubts, the unit that sends personnel to participate in the investigation team should also have no direct interest in the accident under investigation. Therefore, Zhangjiang Town Government, as the project owner of the involved new construction project, should, under circumstances where it could potentially be a subject of investigation, voluntarily recuse itself and refrain from participating in the investigation process of the involved accident, including the analysis of the accident cause and the determination and handling of accident responsibility. Therefore, the appellant, Pudong New Area Government's argument that the object of recusal should be the members of the investigation team rather than the member units, could not stand.

At the time of the accident, the involved project had not yet been completed and accepted for delivery and was still under construction. Zhangjiang Town Government was both the local people's government of the accident site and the project owner of the new road project identified in the Accident Investigation Report. A production safety accident occurred on the construction site of the new road project constructed by Zhangjiang Town Government during the loading and unloading of vehicles transporting sidewalk bricks used in the project. The accident investigation team naturally should investigate the safety responsibilities of the relevant subjects involved in the under-construction project in the accident. Subjects of investigation should not be predetermined before the investigation begins but should be gradually determined or excluded as the investigation progresses, based on the need to clarify facts and determine responsibility. As mentioned above, Zhangjiang Town Government, as the project owner of the involved under-construction project, could be a subject of investigation. The appellant, Pudong New Area Government, argued in its appeal that the accident occurred during transportation services, not during construction. Before the accident investigation team conducted the investigation and determined accident responsibility, it presupposed that the safety responsibilities that Zhangjiang Town Government, as the project owner, could bear were limited to the construction process, thereby pre-determining that Zhangjiang Town Government was not a subject of investigation for the involved accident. This presupposition clearly lacked basis, and the appellant's related arguments could not stand.

In conclusion, the first-instance court's judgment, which found a violation of legal procedures, revoked the Disputed Reply, and ordered Pudong New Area Government to re-make an administrative act within ninety days from the date the first-instance judgment took effect, was based on clear findings of fact, correct application of law and regulations, and proper procedures, and should be upheld.

Accordingly, the Shanghai High People's Court, in accordance with Article 89(1)(1) of the "Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China," on September 28, 2020, ruled as follows:

Dismiss the appeal and affirm the original judgment.

This judgment is final.
